text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
Tai Shan - (built 1990) 149,516 dwt sold to Norwegian buyers for $26.7 million.
Iron Master - (built 1982) 127,774 dwt sold to Italian buyers for $12/$12.1 million.
Java Sea - (built 1977) 84,141 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $4.2 million.
Ocean Jade - (built 1984) 61,748 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $13/$13.5 million.
Ocean Pearl - (built 1984) 61,748 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $13/$13.5 million.
Ponderosa - (built 1975) 38,808 dwt purchased by mortgagess at auction in Dunkirk for $3.7 million and resold to Greek buyers for $4.3 million.
Iowa Trader - (built 1981) 37,061 dwt sold to Mexican buyers for $4.5 million.
Prosperus - (built 1983) 35,676 dwt sold to Greek or Turkish buyers for $8.5/$8.7 million.
Capo Mele Second - (built 1978) 16,324 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $3 million.
NOL Canopus - (built 1983) 64,711 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $8.6 million.
Clipper Unity - (built 1973) 8,001 dwt sold to Turkish buyers for $1.4 million.
